notes: them (t007) is placed on the infinitive under rule 74; reading it as the object of bade and folding it onto εἶπεν remains defensible, but rule 74 asks which verb the supplied word is an argument of.
of the leaven takes of on the expressed ἀπό and the (t011) on the article, while of bread has no determiner, so its article is unrepresented and of rides with the noun (rules 21, 23).
